games.name: Heian [OPEN TESTING]
games.desc:
A game inspired by the Golden Age of Jujutsu.
There is no permadeath involved in the game.

Controls:
Q - Dodge
R - Critical
M1 - Basic attack
M2 - Feint
Tab - Inventory
2x W - Run
F - Parry / Block
B - Grip + Mouse
V - Carry
C - Charge CE
C + X - Curse Sense

Mechanics:
Roll Cancelling - Q + M2
Feinting - M1 + M2 or Skill
Running Attack - M1 while sprinting
Uptilt - Hold CTRL + M1
Aerial - M1 in Air
Chase - M1 during Aerial
M - Meditate (used to unlock moves)

You can unequip equipments through settings.
You can wipe / delete your character through the red skull icon in your slots UI
You can recall ur skills by clicking on the learned skill twice
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Programming: usdhha, NokiSou, DavidLocious
Building: RenneOri
Modelling: RenneOri
Animating: usdhha, NokiSou
VFX: pkvfx, usdhha, NokiSou
